ceu: ✦ The conjunction between Mercury and Uranus

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
From {H:1810047632000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
Mercury and Uranus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
From {H:1810047632000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to home and family.

Mercury and Uranus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on your money and what you value. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
From {H:1810047632000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
Mercury and Uranus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on your image and your personal energy. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
From {H:1810047632000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
Mercury and Uranus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on rest and your inner life. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
From {H:1810047632000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
Mercury and Uranus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on friends and plans for the future. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
From {H:1810047632000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
Mercury and Uranus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on your career and your goals. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
From {H:1810047632000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

Mercury and Uranus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
From {H:1810047632000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

Mercury and Uranus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
From {H:1810047632000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
Mercury and Uranus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on relationships and partnerships. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
From {H:1810047632000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
Mercury and Uranus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on routine, daily work and health. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
From {H:1810047632000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
Mercury and Uranus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
From {H:1810047632000}, the Moon moves into {S:4} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
Mercury and Uranus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, surprises and the urge to change, all focused on home and family. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.
